title: Nine Willow Rods
subtitle: 手工艺 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 手工艺（文学艺术与体育·手工艺与创造）
meta: 主题语境：手工艺（文学艺术与体育·手工艺与创造）　|　核心词汇：basket　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 basket 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my grandmother wove ① a basket out of nine willow rods and gave it away within a week, and my mother said the giving was the whole of the making. The ② basket, meaning the thing itself and not the weaving, came back in 1959 with two broken ribs and was mended; a basket, she said, is the only object you can repair by remembering how it began.

Every ③ basket in that house had been mended at least once, and the ④ basket by the door, meaning the one for the eggs and not either of those, was the only one she refused to let anybody carry. A basket, my grandfather said, is nine parts willow and one part knowing when to stop; my grandmother said the stopping is the part that takes years.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ basket was the whole of the harvest, meaning the measure and not the weaving. The ⑥ basket, meaning the unit people counted in and not any of that, is the only measure that changes size with the crop; a basket, he said, is either something you weave or the only word that means both a container and an amount. She said the amount is the part they argue about.

By 1966 the ⑦ basket had become a photograph in a magazine, and the photograph had become an argument about whether it was craft. The ⑧ basket of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in April, was nine rods and eleven years of eggs; a basket, she said, is either the thing by the door or the reason you learned to count a harvest. He said the counting never agreed with anybody.

The ⑨ basket I remember is the one for the eggs, which was still in use in 1971 and was never sold. A ⑩ basket, my mother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being mended; every basket, she said, is a measure that has agreed to look like a container. She said the measure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 篮子（指那个东西本身，与编织相对）
C. 固定搭配：weave a basket 编一只篮子
D. n. 篮子（指屋里每一只）
E. n. 篮子（指门边那一只）
F. n. 一篮的量；计量单位（指收成）
G. n. 计量单位（抽象：人们用来计数的那个单位）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a basket out of nine willow rods
The basket, meaning the thing itself and not the weaving
basket was the whole of the harvest
The basket, meaning the unit people counted in
the basket had become a photograph in a magazine
The basket of the whole thing
A basket, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: weave a basket 意为“编一只篮子”，1947 年祖母用九根柳条编了一只篮子，一周之内就送了人。
basket 意为“篮子”，指那个东西本身而不是编织，它 1959 年回来时断了两根肋，被补好了。
basket 指屋里每一只篮子，那屋里每一只都至少补过一次。
basket 指门边那一只（装鸡蛋的那一只），是她唯一不许别人碰的。
basket 意为“一篮的量、计量单位”，指收成，父亲说篮子就是那次收成的全部。
basket 为抽象用法，指人们用来计数的那个单位，是唯一会随收成改变大小的量器。
basket 意为“篮子”，到 1966 年这个 basket 成了杂志上的一张照片。
basket 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖母四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九根柳条和十一年的鸡蛋。
basket 意为“篮子”，我记得的是装鸡蛋那一只，1971 年还在用，从没被卖掉。
basket 为抽象总称，母亲说篮子是唯一会因为被补过而变好的东西。
